ISSUE 024 · THE SLOW LIVING SERIES

A slower kind
of Sunday.

Finding a little more room for the things that matter. A field guide to taking the long way home.

WORDS BY ALEX MORGAN
“Sometimes the most productive thing
you can do is simply notice.”NOTES FROM THE WEEKEND
01 / BEGIN WHERE YOU ARE

There is no perfect place to start.

The morning arrived slowly. No alarms, no list of places to be. Just a patch of sunlight moving across the kitchen floor, and the quiet promise of a day without a plan.

We took the path through the old orchard. The trees were just beginning to turn, and somewhere beyond the stone wall a dog was making a very convincing case for staying outside.

A sticky section heading that must stay in the captured document.
Leave a little room for the unexpected.
It tends to be where the good things happen.

The art of paying attention.

Put your phone away for a moment. Take the longer route. Ask a question you do not already know the answer to. These are small things, but small things have a way of adding up.

Private reference: 4829-7391

Somewhere along the way, we stopped thinking about where we were going and started enjoying where we were. That felt like enough.

A little less hurry. A little more here.
See you out there.
